Ben van Kerkwyk returns to the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 2417, another loose hang with a show regular. Van Kerkwyk's UnchartedX work studies ancient stone sites with a measurer's care. On Rogan's couch, though, he is mostly a friend of the show, and the talk stays easy.

The two trade stories and laughs across a long, agenda-free session. Listeners who know his careful site videos will hear the warmer, funnier man behind the calipers. The episode is filed as a complete record of the visit, a reminder that the show's regulars are booked as much for company as for content.
